description: A CRM dataset in Meta Events Manager. Facebook leads reaching the stages below are sent to it, so Meta's Conversion Leads goal learns which leads convert.

fields.label: Meta Dataset

fields.description: A name to recognise the dataset in lists. It changes nothing.
fields.label: Dataset Name

fields.description: The Dataset ID from Events Manager. It is not secret.
fields.label: Dataset ID

fields.description: When stage changes are read and sent to Meta.
fields.label: Sending

fields.description: Off, nothing is read or sent for this dataset.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: The newest stage change already handled. Each run reads from here.
fields.label: Read Up To
